content: Andrej Karpathy built HackerTube, a YouTube alternative, in two hours using Claude Opus 5.5. The platform curates videos based on Hacker News recommendations rather than engagement metrics, prioritizing community vetting over algorithmic feeds. It lacks login requirements and uses simple video frames as thumbnails. Although it relies on existing YouTube data and Hacker News history, this project demonstrates how AI agents can rapidly restructure information distribution.
